up: Retrieve compounds linked to the document CHEMBL5344418 along with their ChEMBL IDs, compound names, maximum drug development phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. The output rows must be ordered alphabetically by the ChEMBL ID (ascending) and should include only one row per compound (distinct compounds). The requested data elements are: (1) the public ChEMBL identifier for each compound (derived from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), (2) the compound name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), (3) the maximum drug development phase (molecule_dictionary.max_phase), (4) the molecule type (molecule_dictionary.molecule_type), and (5) the canonical SMILES string (compound_structures.canonical_smiles). No additional filters or joins are required beyond linking the document to its associated compounds via the relationship between docs.doc_id, compound_records.doc_id, and compound_dictionary.molregno.
sql: WITH doc AS (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5344418') SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS chembl_id, md.pref_name AS compound_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM doc d JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = cr.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno ORDER BY chembl_id ASC
